project: The Virtual Playhouse: AI Classic Theatre & Audience Simulator

build.revisionNote: Added the full-cast speech engine, sound-on entry gate, Voice Cast panel and optional ambient bed (off by default).
build.credits: Built with OpenCode and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

notes: Token counts are read from the OpenCode session database at completion time. This revision includes the full-cast speech engine and the ambient-drone default-off change. The final assistant reply is sent after this snapshot, so the live session may be a few tokens higher. Cache-read tokens are included in total because they represent context processed by the model.
